scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Exhaustive finite discrete-Morse certificate: full face enumeration, transfer counts, complete acyclicity, exact signed Morse differential and unit Smith factors.

scientific_limitations: Exact finite claim for the categorical product of the eight-cycle with the four-vertex complete graph only; no all-size formula and no independent mathematical validation.
title: An integral two-degree sphere wedge for the eight-cycle categorical product with four colors
